title: My Account
subtitle: Manage Dokng accounts and deploy to your CLIs in one click
addSubtitle: Paste your Dokng API Key to bind an account, then use “Deploy to apps” on its card to activate
namePlaceholder: Leave blank to use the remote name
bindSuccess: Key bound. Use “Deploy to apps” on its card to activate
applySubtitle: Select the apps to write and activate. Only the selected apps are changed; others are untouched.
deleteConfirm: Delete account "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
bindPartial: Key saved, but {{count}} apps failed to add it
noTargetApps: No supported apps are available. Enable an app in Settings first.
emptyDesc: Create an API Key in the Dokng console, then paste it here. Keys stay on this machine, and can be deployed to every CLI in one click.
emptyGetKey: Get an API Key from Dokng
deeplinkMissingKey: Import link is missing an API key
deeplinkSuccess: Key imported. Apply it to your CLIs from its card.
deeplinkDuplicate: This key is already bound; nothing was added
